# 3d-cylinder-column

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. Stepped glossy cylinders with bent 3D arrows to labels. Backdrop: Pale studio, reflective floor. Items: 3 to 6. Default aspect: landscape.

| Ref | Shows | Flags |

## Colour palette

- Warm ramp default, one colour per cylinder in order: yellow #F7C11B, orange #F5851F, red-orange #E8482B, crimson #C2182B; extend with magenta #E4327A and purple #7B3FA0 for five or six items
- Full family cycle allowed when the content is not ranked
- Arrow matches its cylinder colour; icon near-black #2B2F36 on the face
- Pale grey studio backdrop #F4F6F9, floor plane with a faint mirrored reflection of each cylinder

## Visual elements

- Cylinders with a visible open top (darker inner ellipse), glossy vertical highlight on the left, side shading on the right
- Heights step evenly; tallest cylinder first for a descending rank, last for an ascending build
- Arrow: a thick ribbon emerging from inside the cylinder, bending 90 degrees, ending in a flat chevron head pointing at the label
- Label block: large bold numeral over a small caps word, then a bold title and two lines of light description to the right
- One icon per cylinder centred on the face, flat, single colour

## Typography

- Family typography; numerals are the largest text after the title, titles bold caps, descriptions light charcoal

## Composition rules

- Three to six cylinders; more than six, switch to 3d-slab-stack
- Cylinders occupy the lower two thirds of a landscape canvas; arrows and labels stagger upward so no label overlaps another
- Portrait: cylinders narrower and closer, arrows shorter, labels stacked in one column on the right
- Reading order follows the arrows, left to right

## Layout

### Structure

- Three to six cylinders in a row on a reflective floor
- Heights step evenly; tallest first for a descending rank, last for an ascending build
- One bent arrow per cylinder, out of the top, 90-degree turn, pointing sideways to the label
- Label block per cylinder: numeral, caps word, title, description
- Optional icon on each cylinder face

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Descending** | Ranked priorities, funnels, countdowns | Tallest at the left, heights fall to the right |
| **Ascending** | Growth, maturity, build-up | Shortest at the left, heights climb to the right |
| **Bar chart** | Data with narrative | Height encodes the value, numeral shows it |

### Visual elements

- Cylinders with a visible open top and a glossy vertical highlight
- Arrows as thick ribbons in the cylinder colour, flat chevron heads
- Flat single-colour icon centred on each face
- Faint mirrored reflection on the floor plane
- Warm ramp of colours left to right, or the family cycle

### Text placement

- Title at top, left-aligned
- Large numeral over a small caps word at each arrow head
- Bold title and two-line description to the right of the numeral
- Labels stagger upward with the arrows so none overlap
- Reading order follows the arrows, left to right

Arrows stagger so labels never overlap. Pale grey studio backdrop, soft floor reflection, top-left highlights. Geometric sans-serif type. No hand-drawn lines, no paper texture, no cartoon characters, no photographic realism, no watermarks, no placeholder or lorem ipsum text. Clean premium business-template 3D.

## Best for

- Ranked steps and priorities
- Stage sequences and maturity levels
- Countdowns
- Bar-chart data with a label per bar
